## What the plan does

Makes `/issue` Step 10d's `-z "$PR"` arm payload-aware. Today it skips unconditionally and posts nothing, so a code-bearing branch whose draft PR was never created is left permanently unmerged with the durable record reading clean (#456→#466 class), and the watcher's `completed_unmerged_pass` is blind to it because no marker is posted. Both no-usable-PR cases — terminal PR (#1897) and no PR at all (#2240) — now consult the same layered novel-payload predicate through a shared prelude and a `USABLE_PR` gate.
